---
title: "Numeric features"
---

Steps that reshape numeric columns, one column at a time (the grouping follows
[Feature Engineering A–Z](https://feaz-book.com/)). In the
[eight-position ordering](../basics/four-stages-eight-steps.qmd) these fill
[Wrangle: transforms](../four-stages/wrangle-transforms.qmd) and
[Model prep: normalize](../four-stages/model-prep-normalize.qmd).

Three steps to know:

- `StepNormalize` — center and scale to z-scores.
- `StepPolynomial` — expand a column into polynomial basis features.
- A log transform for skewed columns — planned, see
  [#208](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/issues/208).

*Stub — content to come.*
